answer: Thirty-two berths open per epoch in the harbor, one 20-minute window. A claimant moors one vessel; its crystal lens catches the zephyr, flashing a block-seeded pattern. Three witnesses sign each mooring, two at most. Entry locks 80 POA, +45 per extra identity from one root: ten fakes lock 2,825 POA. One operator moors two at most: ten fakes need five hands, ten moorings, thirty signatures, fifteen strangers. Berths open one every forty seconds, so the tenth fake waits six minutes; a missed gust burns 25. The lens photographs each hand on its tiller — one hand on two tillers voids both bonds.
